sentences.text:
No. 13.09.2024  08.
 1.
The petitioner is an accused in connection with Nikirei P.S. Case No.73 of 2019 corresponding to S.T. Case No.155 of 2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 457/397/376 of the IPC pending in the Court of the learned Additional Sessions Judge, FTSC, Kendrapara.

entities.text: Court of the learned Additional Sessions Judge, FTSC, Kendrapara
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The petitioner is aggrieved by the order dated 01.12.2023 passed by the learned Additional District Judge, FTSC, Kendrapara in S.T. Case No.155 of 2023, whereby the charges have been framed against him for the offences punishable under Sections 457/397/307/376-D of the IPC.
3. Mr. Chand, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that five accused persons were subjected to trial for the same offence under the F.I.R. in subject.

4. The learned Ad hoc Additional Sessions Judge, FTSC, Kendrapara vide judgment dated 17.06.2023 has acquitted four of the accused persons and convicted one accused person and sentenced the said convict accused to undergo R.I. for three years and to pay fine of Rs.5,000/-
(Rupees five thousand).
5.

entities.text: Ad hoc Additional Sessions Judge, FTSC, Kendrapara
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner is stated to have been absconding, for which the trial has been splitting up in the present case.
Subsequently, the petitioner has been apprehended and the charge has been framed by the impugned order.

sentences.text: 6. Mr. Chand, learned counsel for the petitioner confines his prayer to the expeditious disposal of the trial.
7. Regard being had to the aforementioned facts, I am inclined to allow the prayer made by the learned counsel for the petitioner.
8. The learned trial Court is directed to do well to see that the trial of the present case qua the petitioner is disposed of, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of five months.
9. With the aforementioned observation, the CRLMC is disposed of.
(S.S. Mishra) Judge Subhasis Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack.
